Underneath that correct terminal is a harder finding, measured rather than asserted (P2_COMPARISON_RESOLUTION_2026-08-22). Both completed campaigns ran at the measurement floor. The frozen rule requires an average-IoU delta of 0.03 before superiority is supported, and every arm in both campaigns scores about 0.004, so the entire measured performance of the best arm is smaller than the difference the campaign exists to detect. Deleting a competing arm outright would not reach the threshold. Everything else follows: all 399 paired questions tie, the bootstrap interval is [0.0, 0.0] which reads as the strongest possible equivalence evidence and is instead the signature of an instrument with no resolution, and in V3 three distinct candidate files produced one byte-identical evaluator output. In V1 the three arms shared one candidate digest outright, so that campaign scored a single system against itself three times.

That means finding out why retrieval scores near zero on a benchmark whose own gold is reachable -- which the resolution audit deliberately does not diagnose, because it measures the instrument and not the retrieval. Only then are the route families #650 enumerates worth building: missing-route, retrieved-but-unprocessed, duplicated, contradictory, provider-invalid, apparently-saturated. work_queue.statement: This is the terminal the resolution finding matters most to, because a non-inferiority guard is exactly what a degenerate interval would wrongly discharge. It is instead a zero-width interval over identical differences, which a bootstrap produces at any sample size, and it arises because every arm sits at the measurement floor -- about 0.004 average IoU against a frozen required delta of 0.03. Route-level and task-level closure receipts over a naturalistic arena are still missing, which was the original statement and remains true; what is added is that the instrument that would carry them currently has no resolution, so collecting receipts through it would produce another interval that could not have come out any other way. Three reporting defects travel with both artifacts: they publish the unseeded max_iou_at_k family that the paper's own score_wide_comparison.py excludes by rule, that family decreases in k which a maximum over the top k cannot do, and every runtime total is exactly zero, which is untransported measurement rather than measured cost.

Then require closure receipts per route and per task in the campaign schema before outcomes are accessed. The guard exists and reports both campaigns as ZERO_RESOLUTION; wiring it into the campaign's own terminal rule is the step that has not been taken.

work_queue.statement: The representation-length and format-prior attacks have now been run, and one of them succeeds. Length does not explain the typed arm; it explains most of the untyped comparator, which drops 0.906 to 0.609 under an equal-token control while typed holds 1.0. Format prior does succeed: TYPED_SERIALIZED_BAG moves 0.75 to 0.50 under a bijection on the value alphabet that preserves every gold label, so the published typed-minus-serialized margin measures which symbols were drawn rather than the information the representation carries. The surviving margin is the one the existing failure record already identified, TYPED_RELATIONAL minus UNTYPED_PAIR at +0.09375, whose both arms are orbit-invariant. A prior question has now been put to the battery that produced that result, and one of its three hostile variants turns out never to have attacked anything (P9_ATTACK_POTENCY_2026-08-22). Fifteen of the twenty-four (variant, arm) cells leave the arm's feature vector unchanged on all 512 instances, and eight of those fifteen are the whole ORDER_PERMUTATION row. That variant's dataset is identical to the base, manifest digest included: it reverses every sequence-valued coordinate and then rebuilds through a normaliser that maps each one to tuple(sorted(set(...))), so the reversal is undone on the following line. The consequence is larger than a wiring bug. Ordering is not representable in MethodRealization at all -- the coordinates the battery names as sequences are stored as sorted sets -- so repairing the wiring would not produce an order attack, and the order-blindness of every feature family follows from the same fact rather than being a separate coincidence. PC-2_GOLD_PRESERVATION reports zero labels changed over 512 instances for that variant, which is trivially true of an identity. EQUAL_LENGTH reaches seven of eight arms on 112 instances each and SEMANTIC_ORBIT reaches two of eight on all 512, so this is a statement about specific cells and not about the battery, which is otherwise careful and already refuses a contrast whose comparator answered with a single label.
work_queue.unblock: The attacks now exist as runnable gates with stated denominators, so what is owed is not instrumentation. Two things. Withdraw or re-scope the typed-minus-serialized sentence in the manuscript, since its margin is alphabet-dependent. And run both attacks against the result they were written for -- the frozen Qwen2.5 successor run of #618, which has no outcome here and cannot be reached: this execution was against D1 v1.2, the only representation contrast P9 currently publishes, and that scope is stated in the artifact. Before any of that: add the precondition the battery is missing, which is its own eligibility rule one level earlier -- an attack cannot fail against an input it did not change, so a (variant, arm) cell whose feature vectors are unchanged must read NOT_ATTACKED rather than held. Then decide what to do about ORDER_PERMUTATION. It cannot be repaired in place; either the comparison coordinates carry an order in the representation, in which case the variant becomes a real attack and the feature families stop being order-blind for free, or the variant is withdrawn and the claim it appeared to support is withdrawn with it. The same normaliser drops duplicates, so a multiplicity attack is unavailable for the same reason and would be the second thing a carrying representation buys.

work_queue.statement: The blocker this replaces named PR #733 as in-flight upstream work. #733 was closed unmerged on 2026-08-21, superseded by #752, which also closed unmerged after running. So nothing is in flight, and two completed campaigns now exist whose results the ledger had not recorded. V2 never scored: its repeated-pid crosswalk probe returned HTTP 200 with an empty results array, below its prospectively frozen minimum of one, so acquisition never started. V3 changed the crosswalk encoding, did run all 400 rows, and terminated P2_WIDE_EXTERNAL_V3_CANNOT_CHECK on provider validity: 0.716 against a frozen 0.90. Underneath that correct terminal is a harder finding, measured rather than asserted (P2_COMPARISON_RESOLUTION_2026-08-22). Both completed campaigns ran at the measurement floor. The frozen rule requires an average-IoU delta of 0.03 before superiority is supported, and every arm in both campaigns scores about 0.004, so the entire measured performance of the best arm is smaller than the difference the campaign exists to detect. Deleting a competing arm outright would not reach the threshold. Everything else follows: all 399 paired questions tie, the bootstrap interval is [0.0, 0.0] which reads as the strongest possible equivalence evidence and is instead the signature of an instrument with no resolution, and in V3 three distinct candidate files produced one byte-identical evaluator output. In V1 the three arms shared one candidate digest outright, so that campaign scored a single system against itself three times.
work_queue.unblock: Raise the arms off the floor before running another campaign; a fourth transport version scored at IoU 0.004 would spend the same effort to learn the same nothing. That means finding out why retrieval scores near zero on a benchmark whose own gold is reachable -- which the resolution audit deliberately does not diagnose, because it measures the instrument and not the retrieval. Only then are the route families #650 enumerates worth building: missing-route, retrieved-but-unprocessed, duplicated, contradictory, provider-invalid, apparently-saturated. Independently of all of it, this terminal is PROTECTED_SUPERIORITY and admits only PROSPECTIVE_PROTECTED evidence, which requires external evaluator custody that no campaign here has had.

work_queue.statement: This is the terminal the resolution finding matters most to, because a non-inferiority guard is exactly what a degenerate interval would wrongly discharge. Both completed Wide campaigns report a paired interval of [0.0, 0.0] over 399 matched questions with 399 ties, no wins and no losses. Read at face value that is conclusive equivalence. It is instead a zero-width interval over identical differences, which a bootstrap produces at any sample size, and it arises because every arm sits at the measurement floor -- about 0.004 average IoU against a frozen required delta of 0.03. Route-level and task-level closure receipts over a naturalistic arena are still missing, which was the original statement and remains true; what is added is that the instrument that would carry them currently has no resolution, so collecting receipts through it would produce another interval that could not have come out any other way. Three reporting defects travel with both artifacts: they publish the unseeded max_iou_at_k family that the paper's own score_wide_comparison.py excludes by rule, that family decreases in k which a maximum over the top k cannot do, and every runtime total is exactly zero, which is untransported measurement rather than measured cost.
work_queue.unblock: Require the resolution audit to pass before a campaign's paired interval is allowed to discharge anything: an interval from an all-ties split, from arms whose evaluator output is byte-identical, or from arms below the campaign's own frozen effect threshold must map to CANNOT_CHECK rather than to non-inferiority. Then require closure receipts per route and per task in the campaign schema before outcomes are accessed. The guard exists and reports both campaigns as ZERO_RESOLUTION; wiring it into the campaign's own terminal rule is the step that has not been taken.

work_queue.statement: Still no new identity coordinate, but the reason has changed and the old one was wrong. The unblock assumed a mining input that does not exist: across all three atlases the current system produces zero false merges and zero false splits (0 of 4, 0 of 6, 0 of 42), so there is nothing to mine a coordinate from. The one candidate derivable from the corpus, a per-coordinate observation status, was frozen and tested and fails its novelty gate by construction -- it is constant across every fully observed pair, so it is a third value on the existing axes rather than a new axis (P3_PARTIAL_OBSERVATION_RESULT_2026-08-21, overall FAIL). A second reading of the same emptiness is now on record and points at what to build (P3_PANEL_RESOLUTION_2026-08-22). Four of the six registered ablations -- remove_construct, remove_measurement, remove_referent, remove_temporal_context -- move none of accuracy, false merge or false split, each with a zero-width interval; only forcing compatibility without the obstruction distinction and removing the modality/polarity/attribution/discourse group move anything. P3's manuscript already says this and preserves those zeros as coverage limitations rather than reading them as dispensability, which is the correct reading and the only one the artifact supports. What the audit adds is that four coordinates are named as untestable on this corpus, executably, rather than in a results paragraph -- so the corpus a successor coordinate would have to be mined from is the one that makes those four consultable, not merely one with false merges in it.
work_queue.unblock: The mining input has to be built before it can be mined. That means an adjudicated corpus containing cases the current coordinates actually get wrong, which is the same corpus P3-U-T1 and T2 are blocked on -- so this terminal is downstream of the arena, not independent of it. One thing the probe did establish is worth carrying into that corpus: it must contain partially observed pairs. Every existing atlas observes each coordinate on both sides or neither, which is why the over-resolution guard ran with a zero denominator, and a new corpus built the same way would inherit the same blind spot.

work_queue.statement: The representation-length and format-prior attacks have now been run, and one of them succeeds. Length does not explain the typed arm; it explains most of the untyped comparator, which drops 0.906 to 0.609 under an equal-token control while typed holds 1.0. Format prior does succeed: TYPED_SERIALIZED_BAG moves 0.75 to 0.50 under a bijection on the value alphabet that preserves every gold label, so the published typed-minus-serialized margin measures which symbols were drawn rather than the information the representation carries. The surviving margin is the one the existing failure record already identified, TYPED_RELATIONAL minus UNTYPED_PAIR at +0.09375, whose both arms are orbit-invariant. A prior question has now been put to the battery that produced that result, and one of its three hostile variants turns out never to have attacked anything (P9_ATTACK_POTENCY_2026-08-22). Fifteen of the twenty-four (variant, arm) cells leave the arm's feature vector unchanged on all 512 instances, and eight of those fifteen are the whole ORDER_PERMUTATION row. That variant's dataset is identical to the base, manifest digest included: it reverses every sequence-valued coordinate and then rebuilds through a normaliser that maps each one to tuple(sorted(set(...))), so the reversal is undone on the following line. The consequence is larger than a wiring bug. Ordering is not representable in MethodRealization at all -- the coordinates the battery names as sequences are stored as sorted sets -- so repairing the wiring would not produce an order attack, and the order-blindness of every feature family follows from the same fact rather than being a separate coincidence. PC-2_GOLD_PRESERVATION reports zero labels changed over 512 instances for that variant, which is trivially true of an identity. EQUAL_LENGTH reaches seven of eight arms on 112 instances each and SEMANTIC_ORBIT reaches two of eight on all 512, so this is a statement about specific cells and not about the battery, which is otherwise careful and already refuses a contrast whose comparator answered with a single label.
work_queue.unblock: The attacks now exist as runnable gates with stated denominators, so what is owed is not instrumentation. Two things. Withdraw or re-scope the typed-minus-serialized sentence in the manuscript, since its margin is alphabet-dependent. And run both attacks against the result they were written for -- the frozen Qwen2.5 successor run of #618, which has no outcome here and cannot be reached: this execution was against D1 v1.2, the only representation contrast P9 currently publishes, and that scope is stated in the artifact. Before any of that: add the precondition the battery is missing, which is its own eligibility rule one level earlier -- an attack cannot fail against an input it did not change, so a (variant, arm) cell whose feature vectors are unchanged must read NOT_ATTACKED rather than held. Then decide what to do about ORDER_PERMUTATION. It cannot be repaired in place; either the comparison coordinates carry an order in the representation, in which case the variant becomes a real attack and the feature families stop being order-blind for free, or the variant is withdrawn and the claim it appeared to support is withdrawn with it. The same normaliser drops duplicates, so a multiplicity attack is unavailable for the same reason and would be the second thing a carrying representation buys.

work_queue.statement: There is no identifiability audit that runs as a gate, and without one no score from this benchmark can be used at all -- that is what H3 taught. What now exists is one leg of it, executable (P4_PANEL_RESOLUTION_2026-08-22): read each metric across every system in a published panel and ask whether it takes more than one value. Run over the V2 panel it reports that two of the three hypotheses are decided on metrics no system varies on -- clean_coverage is exactly 1.0 for all eleven systems, so H2 reports [0.0, 0.0] and PASS, and correct_cannot_check_rate is also 1.0 for all eleven, so H3 reports [0.0, 0.0] and NOT_SUPPORTED. Saturation is not a bias toward optimism: the same panel yields one PASS and one NOT_SUPPORTED from it. Only false_promotion_rate discriminates, over six distinct values, and H1's interval is earned. None of this is new to the paper: P4's manuscript already states it in prose, with the same counts, and already concludes that H2 and H3 'should be read as design limits rather than as comparative findings'. What was missing is that the limitation was a caveat rather than a gate, and that the ledger did not carry it at all. The later identifiable V3 panel repairs correct_cannot_check_rate, which varies there; clean_coverage remains saturated at 1.0 across every system in both constructions.
work_queue.unblock: Make the identifiability audit a precondition gate that runs before any score is read, not a post-hoc report -- and make the saturation check its cheapest leg, since it needs only the per-system rates and would have refused H2 in both constructions rather than leaving it to a limitations paragraph. Then the harder leg the H3 lesson names: labels provably unrecoverable from evidence-list length, missingness pattern, template or source count. A clean-coverage guard also needs a construction containing clean positives that a weaker governance mechanism actually declines; the paper says as much, and until such cases exist non-inferiority on that metric cannot be a comparative finding.

work_queue.statement: The unblock has been performed and the terminal is not thereby discharged; what changed is that the extension now exists and can be inspected. A counterexample the whole lifting battery accepted, science_lifts_without_donor, was traced to a missing primitive rather than patched: the semantics could not express the projection from a lifted state to the donor certificate under it, so conservativity could only be stated about the donor atom, which is how it became a comparison of a name against itself. Adding the projection, an enriched donor product built from the donor theory's own validator over a requirement set enlarged by the scientific coordinates, and donor-valid transitions repaired five checks that had refuted nothing; both checkers moved FAIL to PASS and every published count and digest was preserved. The ad hoc alternative -- a one-line 'nothing lifts without a valid donor' exception -- is kept beside the extension, unshipped, with a test pinning that its refuted set is a strict subset, so the distinction this terminal asks about is a comparison a reviewer can run. What remains is a judgement about whether one such episode establishes the practice, which is a grading call and not a further repair.
